cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14.4)
project(gps_msgs)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

set(MSG_DEPS builtin_interfaces std_msgs )

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(builtin_interfaces REQUIRED)
find_package(rosidl_default_generators REQUIRED)
find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)

# The hand-written messages, listed by name.
set(MSG_FILES
  msg/GPSFix.msg
  msg/GPSStatus.msg
)

# The GPSD* messages are generated by tools/generate_raw_msgs.py, one per GPSd
# C API (MAJOR, MINOR) pair plus GPSDJson. They are globbed rather than listed
# so regenerating does not also require editing this file; CI runs the
# generator with --check so the checked-in set cannot drift.
#
# The glob is on the GPSD prefix, not on msg/*.msg, because this package holds
# both kinds: the prefix is the only thing separating generated messages from
# the hand-written ones above, and the generator's orphan scan keys on that
# same prefix so a rename can never leave a stale file behind for this glob to
# pick up as a second definition of a message.
#
# Note they are built unconditionally, with no libgps dependency: this is a
# pure interface package and must stay buildable everywhere.
file(GLOB GENERATED_MSG_FILES RELATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} msg/GPSD*.msg)
list(SORT GENERATED_MSG_FILES)
list(LENGTH GENERATED_MSG_FILES GENERATED_MSG_COUNT)
if(GENERATED_MSG_COUNT EQUAL 0)
  message(FATAL_ERROR
    "No GPSD*.msg found in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/msg. They are generated: "
    "run tools/generate_raw_msgs.py")
endif()
message(STATUS "gps_msgs: generating ${GENERATED_MSG_COUNT} GPSd messages")

rosidl_generate_interfaces(${PROJECT_NAME}
  ${MSG_FILES}
  ${GENERATED_MSG_FILES}
  DEPENDENCIES ${MSG_DEPS}
)

ament_export_dependencies(rosidl_default_runtime)

#############
## Testing ##
#############

if(BUILD_TESTING)
  find_package(ament_cmake_pytest REQUIRED)

  # The generator's tests live with the generator rather than with a package,
  # and run here because this package owns its output.
  #
  # Neither suite links or needs libgps -- they read gps.h out of a GPSd git
  # clone and skip cleanly when it is absent, so this package stays buildable
  # and testable on the build farm. Point GPSD_REPO at a clone to run them:
  #
  #   GPSD_REPO=/path/to/gpsd colcon test --packages-select gps_msgs
  #
  # tools/test_against_gpsd.sh maintains one at <workspace>/.gpsd_versions/gpsd,
  # which is the default.
  set(GENERATOR_TESTS
    test_generate_raw_msgs.py      # generator internals, synthetic fragments
    test_generated_messages.py     # generated output vs. the real gps.h
  )
  foreach(test_file ${GENERATOR_TESTS})
    ament_add_pytest_test(${test_file}
      "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tools/${test_file}"
      TIMEOUT 600)
  endforeach()
endif()

ament_package()
